notes.title: Happy Spunksgiving
notes.notes:
It’s the season of giving and these Girls Next Door are getting into the holiday spirit!

We’ve just released a major update to the game, which includes many improvements to lighting, stories, character models and most importantly ….. “The Moneyshot”!

For this new feature, each character has a pleasure intensity meter.  Each position will either increase or decrease the intensity meter, based on the girl’s preferences and the correct timing of the position. Try not to jump around too much, but also….. Don’t be too boring!

So get into the holiday spirit, meet your friendly neighbor and treat her to a delicious Spunksgiving dinner!
